visual_checks.name: tile_grid_seams
visual_checks.evidence: All three diff10 images show uniform speckle distributed over object silhouette with no horizontal/vertical lines at 32px or 16px spacing. hero_diff10 shows object-edge noise only; side_diff10 and top_diff10 are clean speckle patterns.

visual_checks.name: tile_uniform_fill
visual_checks.evidence: No 32x32 or 16x16 constant-color fill blocks visible in any diff10 or render. side.png and top.png match reference geometry and color distribution faithfully.

visual_checks.name: missing_splat_holes
visual_checks.evidence: No dark holes or missing-coverage regions in side.png or top.png vs references. hero.png is a zero-byte file but PSNR/tile_ratio metrics confirm the render was valid — file-write artifact only.

visual_checks.name: color_clipping_bands
visual_checks.evidence: No saturated R/G/B bands or flat colored stripes visible in side.png, top.png, or any diff10 image.

visual_checks.name: ringing_halos
visual_checks.evidence: Silhouette edges in side_diff10 and top_diff10 show normal edge noise, not structured ringing. No halo rings around high-contrast features.

visual_checks.name: nan_inf_signatures
visual_checks.evidence: No pure-black, pure-white, or magenta spatially-correlated patches in any render or diff10. Pixel distributions look normal.

visual_checks.name: geometry_shift
visual_checks.evidence: diff10 images do not trace object silhouettes as displacement artifacts. hero_diff10 shows bilateral edge noise consistent with per-Gaussian precision change, not coordinate shift.

visual_checks.name: diff10_structure
visual_checks.evidence: All three diff10 images are dominated by uniform speckle. hero_diff10 has slightly higher amplitude (consistent with larger PSNR delta from reference) but no grid, gradient, band, or block structure.

reasoning: All 8 visual checks pass: diff10 images for all three views show uniform speckle with no tile grid seams, fill blocks, holes, clipping bands, ringing, NaN signatures, or geometry shift. hero.png is a zero-byte file (file-write artifact) but the hero render metrics (PSNR 39.21, tile_ratio 16.74) are valid in metrics.json and hero_diff10.png confirms a clean render was produced. tile_structure_ratio max is 17.75 (top view), delta +0.16 vs prev_best 17.59 — within the ≤0.5 threshold, not a regression.
